functions.name: sync_calendar_events
functions.title: Sync calendar events
functions.description: Syncs Google Calendar events from the CalendarEvents store into FeeLines for invoicing. Call when new calendar events need to be processed into fee lines. Pass start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD) to scope, or omit for the trailing 14-day window.

functions.name: sync_probuild_posts
functions.title: Sync Probuild field reports
functions.description: Pulls Probuild field report posts, extracts man hours and trip charges via LLM, and writes FeeLines and FieldReports. Call when new field reports need to be ingested. Pass start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD) to scope, or omit for the trailing 21-day window through today.

functions.name: audit_field_reports
functions.title: Audit field reports
functions.description: Matches calendar events to Probuild field reports and updates report compliance status. Call to run the audit for a specific date, a date range, or the trailing N days. Pass target_date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a single date, or start_date + end_date for a range, or days_back (default 1) for trailing days. Set force true to re-evaluate already-ok events.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD — range start (inclusive, use with end_date)

days_back.description: Audit trailing N days from yesterday. Default 1

force.description: When true, re-evaluate all events except waived

functions.name: close_month
functions.title: Close month snapshot
functions.description: Creates an immutable snapshot of all fee lines for a month, capturing billed and earned totals for later verification. Requires admin. Pass month (YYYY-MM, required). Set dry_run true to preview the numbers without writing. Set force true to overwrite an existing snapshot.

dry_run.description: When true, compute and return the snapshot without writing to the database

force.description: When true, create a new snapshot even if one already exists for this month

functions.name: get_probuild_status
functions.title: Get Probuild sync status
functions.description: Returns the authenticated Probuild team ID, last token exchange time, and last audit run time. Call to check whether the Probuild connection is active and when data was last synced.

functions.name: search_probuild_projects
functions.title: Search Probuild projects
functions.description: Searches all Probuild projects by name and returns their posts within a date range. Use to find field reports that exist in Probuild but weren't captured by the normal ingest window. Pass search (required, pipe/comma/space-separated terms), optional start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD).

search.description: Required. Name pattern(s) to match, pipe/comma/space-separated (e.g. 'countryside|pearl')

functions.name: get_probuild_project_posts
functions.title: Get Probuild project posts
functions.description: Fetches all posts for a specific Probuild project ID with Denver-converted dates. Use to inspect the raw field reports for a project. Pass project_id (required).

functions.name: debug_match_audit
functions.title: Debug match audit
functions.description: Returns diagnostic data for the field-report matcher: per-event audit status grouped by date, a 30-day posts-per-day histogram, and project scan stats. Use to investigate why a field report was or wasn't matched. Pass optional start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), defaulting to the trailing 21 days.

functions.name: resolve_field_report
functions.title: Resolve field report flag
functions.description: Resolves a field report compliance flag on a calendar event. Actions: 'mark_reported' (admin/manager — report exists but matcher missed it), 'waive' (admin — requires a reason), 'upload' (any user — attach photos/notes as a job note). Pass event_id (required), action (required), and for waive a reason, for upload optional photos (array of URLs) and notes (string).

action.description: Required. mark_reported = report exists but matcher missed it; waive = admin waives the requirement (needs reason); upload = attach photos/notes

photos.description: For action 'upload'. Array of photo URLs to attach.

notes.description: For action 'upload'. Note text for the job note.
